name: mcp-browser-agent
description: Let Claude drive a real browser with Playwright and make HTTP API requests.
long_description: A Model Context Protocol server for browser automation. Navigate, click, fill and select form fields, hover, run JavaScript in the page, take screenshots, and make GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE API requests. Uses your installed Google Chrome by default and falls back to Playwright's Chromium when Chrome is absent (install it once with `npx playwright install chromium`). Local file: URLs are refused unless explicitly enabled, since pages the agent visits can carry instructions aimed at the model.

browser_type.title: Browser
browser_type.description: chrome (your installed Google Chrome, the default), chromium, firefox, webkit or edge.

headless.title: Run headless
headless.description: Run the browser without a visible window. Off by default so you can watch what the agent does.
